prompt: Bug report: on CPU, K-Means training with sparse input (`kmeans::method::lloyd_csr`) and BasicStatistics `compute` with sparse input crash (segmentation fault / heap corruption; occasionally they run but produce garbage) when the input `csr_table` was created with `sparse_indexing::zero_based`. The same matrices passed as a `csr_table` with `sparse_indexing::one_based` work and give correct results. It reproduces with ordinary random sparse matrices of a few hundred rows and a handful of columns. Find and fix the root cause in the library so that zero-based CSR tables work for these algorithms. `bazel` is on PATH; this machine has no GPU. Do not weaken or delete existing tests.
